ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast between the dark fluke body and bleached white background; internal ventral surface displays low macro-contrast with a dominant dark-grey pixel intensity (approx. 85%) and localized high-intensity white rings (approx. 15%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous low-intensity dark-grey base with a spatial distribution of high-contrast white circular ring 'blobs' scattered across both lobes, with higher density observed on the lateral third of each lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute, narrow V-shaped notch; approximately 15-degree interior angle with significant vertical depth relative to the horizontal axis of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular, high-frequency serration profile; distinct jagged peaks and deep valleys extracted along the entire trailing edge boundary, with increased amplitude observed on the right distal lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave-to-convex sweep; the trajectory curves outward from the notch and tapers into narrow, elongated distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive spatial detection of circular, light-grey pixel clusters (rosettes) measuring 5-20 pixels in diameter; clusters are randomly distributed across the visible ventral area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring/lesions (rosettes) across the entire ventral surface; notable irregular topography on the distal tips of both lobes suggests minor tissue loss or acquired irregular growth.
